bifrost: bifrost_app::spellcheck (words tokenizer), bifrost_ui::text (word boundaries), bifrost_ui::detect (data detectors), bifrost_app::locale
summary: BifrOSt has a word tokenizer (alphanumeric runs for spelling) and pattern-based data detection for links, dates, addresses and phone numbers. It has no language recognizer, no linguistic tagger (parts of speech, named entities, lemmas), no embeddings and no custom text model runtime; Locale only knows English and Icelandic.

gaps: Language recognizer: no text language detection and no hypotheses API
Linguistic tagger: no lexical class, lemma, name type or script tags for apps
Embeddings: no word or sentence vectors and no nearest-neighbour search for apps
Custom NLModel runtime for classifiers and word taggers
Sentence and paragraph tokenization; word segmentation is alphanumeric runs, not UAX #29
Named entity recognition: data detectors cover only link, date, address and phone
